notes.text: Changed: Animation setting now allows On, Off, and System Default options
Changed: Modernized 'Fetching mail' account settings screen
Fixed: Application could crash due to memory exhaustion
Fixed: Application could crash when rendering long messages
Fixed: Inline images were shown as attachments instead of displaying in message
Fixed: Server search results could disappear after loading
Fixed: Links failed when trailing punctuation was incorrectly included in URLs
Fixed: Android widget text scaled too large when system font size was increased
Fixed: Cancelling the Thundermail OAuth process incorrectly redirects users to the "Redirecting to Thundermail" screen
Fixed: Custom swipe actions were not restored from exported settings backups
